factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Changes in Equity (page 5) shows GROUP total equity as at 30-09-2025: 167,721; as at 31-12-2024: 163,128. Net profit for period: 13,158. Dividends declared: 8,622.

factual_claims.claim: Total non-current liabilities for the group were EUR 327,356 thousand as at 30 September 2025, down from EUR 331,801 thousand at year-end 2024, including borrowings of EUR 294,351 thousand compared to EUR 301,400 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Financial Position (page 2) shows GROUP total non-current liabilities as at 30-09-2025: 327,356; as at 31-12-2024: 331,801. Borrowings: 294,351 (2025) vs 301,400 (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Total current liabilities decreased to EUR 35,287 thousand from EUR 40,245 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Financial Position (page 2) shows GROUP total current liabilities as at 30-09-2025: 35,287; as at 31-12-2024: 40,245.

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents for the group significantly increased to EUR 54,398 thousand as at 30 September 2025 from EUR 17,203 thousand as at 31 December 2024, alongside a decrease in other financial assets, which include short-term deposits, to EUR 21,074 thousand from EUR 50,399 thousand over the same period.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Cash Flow (page 6) shows GROUP cash and cash equivalents as at 30-09-2025: 54,398; as at 31-12-2024: 17,203.
